params._keyHash: keyHash used by the VRF job
params.linkToken: address of the LINK token contract
params.vrfCoordinator: address of the Chainlink VRF coordinator

params.newHashed: the hash of the new server seed

commitServerSeed(bytes32).notice: manually commit a server seed hash (legacy path or testing)

requestServerSeed().notice: Request a new server seed from Chainlink VRF. The resulting         randomness is stored as the server seed when fulfilled.

revealServerSeed(bytes32).notice: Reveal the previously committed server seed.  The provided seed must         hash to the value stored by the caller.

rotateServerSeed(bytes32).notice: Rotate the server seed hash after the previous one has been revealed.         This allows users to set up a new hashed seed for the next round.
